metadata.source: Hand-digitized from eCFR 33 CFR 165.760 / 165.765 (snapshots 2026-11-16) and the 68D-24.008 amendment notice summary
metadata.notes: Approximate — not survey grade. See each feature's `method`. Palm Beach context polygons intentionally omitted.

properties.name: Port Everglades Fixed Security Zones
properties.notes: Two fixed security zones: (1) Mid-Port to North-Port, all waters west of the line from the northern tip of Berth 22 to the west side of the 17th Street Bridge; (2) waters west of the Intracoastal Waterway to the pier face, from Mid-Port south to the Dania Cut-Off Canal. Transit on the ICW itself is allowed; entry requires permission of the Captain of the Port Miami (305-535-4472, VHF 16). If a large vessel encroaches into the ICW, pass east of the on-scene law enforcement vessel.
properties.method: Geometry from NOAA ENC (US5PEFBA/US5PEFCA, RESARE OBJECTID 78199 + 78202, "Port Everglades Fixed Security Zone", source date 2019-07-12) via encdirect.noaa.gov, fetched 2026-11-16. Checked: all 9 coordinates in 33 CFR 165.760(b)(3) lie within 16 m of NOAA's boundary.

properties.name: Port Everglades Harbor Regulated Navigation Area
properties.notes: Vessels less than 150 m entering and transiting shall proceed at slow speed (fully off plane, settled, no excessive wake). State/local manatee zones still apply.
properties.method: Geometry from NOAA ENC (US5PEFBA, RESARE OBJECTID 78200, "no wake area", 33 CFR 165.765) via encdirect.noaa.gov, fetched 2026-11-16. Checked: the 4 CFR vertices lie within 6 m of NOAA's boundary.

properties.name: Lauderdale Beach ICW Zone
properties.notes: Year-round Slow Speed Minimum Wake, shoreline to shoreline, from 1,500 ft south of the Oakland Park Blvd Bridge to 2,250 ft north of the Sunrise Blvd Bridge. Rule text verified against FAC 68D-24.008(1)(a)15. (history "Amended ... 2-3-26"; FAR notice https://flrules.org/Gateway/View_notice.asp?id=30326291). Missing from the FWC GIS layer (last edited 2025-06-03), so the polygon is hand-digitized and FWC drawing L was not available. Boundaries are perpendicular lines across the ICW; this polygon uses the adjoining GIS idle-zone edges, which the rule defines with the same distances. Not survey grade.
properties.method: Clipped the countywide 68D-24.008(1)(b) ICW polygon (FWC OBJECTID 144) to lon -80.112..-80.1 and lat 26.144316..26.163275. North edge = south edge of GIS OBJECTID 51 (Oakland Park idle zone, ±1,500 ft; bridge ≈ 26.167484); south edge = north edge of GIS OBJECTID 52 (Sunrise idle zone, 2,250 ft N of bridge ≈ 26.138135). Offsets at 1° lat ≈ 364000 ft. Not survey grade.
